cjo_candidate_projection.boundary: A projection for the existing CJO compiler; it is not a Frozen CJO and cannot authorize value, price, BuyBand, report publication, or investment action.
cjo_candidate_projection.central_path: The best-current price-free judgment is a mature compressor engine whose disclosed revenue growth did not prevent a FY2017 collapse in recurring attributable profit under raw-material pressure. Group cash conversion and financing pressure make owner cash conditional, while unsegmented acquisitions and new businesses cannot be granted a growth contribution.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: Official post-cutoff reports show that the recurring compressor earnings reference was materially supported by non-core income or that compressor economics deteriorate despite easing input pressure.
component_decisions.promotion_test: Official disclosures reconcile compressor-level operating cash, working capital, maintenance spending, growth spending, and financing over a comparable period.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: Official reports show that inventory, cash-flow, and borrowing pressure is persistently worse at the mature compressor responsibility boundary than the consolidated figures suggest.
component_decisions.promotion_test: A component-level disclosure demonstrates that the mature compressor engine converts earnings to operating cash after its own working-capital and long-lived-asset needs.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: Official disclosures show further material capital absorption or financing dependence without responsibility-matched earnings and cash evidence.
component_decisions.promotion_test: Official component data link capital invested in each acquired or new business to sustained earnings, cash generation, working capital, and incremental return.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: Official disclosures show that financial-product or foreign-exchange results are being relied upon to support recurring operating earnings.

component_treatments.investment_consequence: The mature compressor engine can anchor the price-free normal-earnings route, while owner-cash recognition remains conditional on group-level cash and financing evidence.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote owner-cash treatment from conditional to base only when official disclosures reconcile compressor cash conversion, working capital, maintenance versus growth spending, and financing to the same component boundary.
component_treatments.reason: Refrigerator and commercial compressors are the disclosed main business; FY2017 identifies Jiaxipera as the main profit source and supplies a three-year recurring attributable-profit record. component_treatments.investment_consequence: This component constrains owner-cash and financing-pressure conclusions on a conditional consolidated basis; it does not authorize a component-specific maintenance-capital estimate.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve to a base owner-cash range only when the issuer supplies responsibility-matched cash flow, working capital, long-lived spending, and borrowings for the mature compressor engine.
component_treatments.reason: FY2017 reports negative operating cash flow, a large inventory increase, higher short-term borrowings, restricted assets, and group-level borrowing flows. The same reports explicitly do not allocate these items among compressor and non-compressor components.

component_treatments.investment_consequence: No incremental earnings, owner-cash, return-on-growth-capital, or primary-route contribution is inferred for these businesses.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve only after official disclosures link each material business or acquisition to revenue, profit, working capital, cumulative capital absorbed, and cash generation on the same responsibility boundary.

component_treatments.investment_consequence: These disclosed items remain outside the base earnings, owner-cash, and primary-route treatment.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Reconsider only if official disclosures establish recurring, attributable, cash-realized economics and a shareholder realization path distinct from the compressor operating engine.

industry_future_thesis.horizon: The next reporting cycles after the 2018-12-31 cutoff.
industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: A mature compressor supply regime in which volume and geographic expansion can coexist with raw-material pressure, customer bargaining, and working-capital absorption.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: The factual three-year recurring-profit record is 184.97 million CNY in FY2015, 203.18 million CNY in FY2016, and 60.29 million CNY in FY2017. industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: For a design-and-production compressor supplier, raw-material cost pressure and the ability to recover it through customers transmit through recurring compressor profit; inventory funding and supplier-payment timing then transmit into aggregate operating cash and short-term financing need.

delta.conservative_treatment: Do not translate group cash conversion into a numeric normal-earnings adjustment.
delta.reason: No component-level cash-to-profit reconciliation or maintenance-versus-growth capital allocation is supplied.

owner_cash.basis: The consolidated operating-cash series directly measures the group owner-cash conversion pressure, subject to the stated conditional consolidated boundary.

calculation_binding.expression: -162,226,447.63 CNY minus 195,461,872.18 CNY equals -357,688,319.81 CNY; zero is retained as the no-deterioration endpoint.

magnitude_evidence.driver_metric: Consolidated net cash generated from operating activities
magnitude_evidence.responsibility_boundary: Consolidated group operating-cash flow; the issuer does not allocate this cash series, working capital, spending, or borrowing to compressor versus non-compressor components.

basis.metric: Attributable net profit after non-recurring items
basis.operating_perimeter: Consolidated ordinary-common-equity record, with non-compressor growth and non-operating items not granted separate base authority.

rows.economic_reason: The three supplied years establish a factual after-tax recurring attributable-profit range while the issuer identifies the compressor business, and Jiaxipera in particular, as central to profit. The range is historical reference evidence, not a forecast or a claim that FY2017 input-cost pressure will reverse.
The aggregate earnings record can include these activities, but the source does not permit a responsibility-matched incremental-return or normal-earnings adjustment.

quantification.conservative_treatment: Do not add any separate growth earnings contribution to the reference range or primary route.
quantification.reason: The supplied reports name the new businesses and acquisition amounts but do not allocate their earnings, cash, capital spending, working capital, or financing.

rows.economic_reason: Financial-product, investee, and forward-exchange outcomes are not established as the mature compressor engine's recurring owner economics.

quantification.conservative_treatment: Exclude these items from a separate base contribution and do not replace the unknown with zero inside the historical reference range.
quantification.reason: The source identifies investment-income and foreign-exchange items but does not provide a tax-adjusted, recurring, ordinary-shareholder cash attribution for an exact normalization adjustment.

valuation_route_request.normal_earnings_input_treatment: Anchor normal earnings only to the 60.29-203.18 million CNY FY2015-FY2017 recurring attributable-profit reference, with no assertion that FY2017 is automatically temporary and no separate new-business contribution.
valuation_route_request.owner_cash_input_treatment: Treat owner cash as conditional and consolidated: FY2017 negative operating cash, inventory growth, short-term borrowing growth, and restricted assets establish pressure, but the evidence cannot assign operating cash, maintenance capital, growth capital, or financing to the compressor engine.
valuation_route_request.permanent_loss_input_treatment: Permanent-loss analysis includes slow erosion from unrecovered cost pressure, working-capital and financing absorption, and unsupported returns on acquisition or project capital; it is not limited to immediate insolvency.
valuation_route_request.route_reasoning: The sole primary model role is a mature-compressor earnings route. It carries a conditional owner-cash boundary because cash flow, capex, working capital, and borrowings are disclosed only for the group. The excluded routes preserve the acquisition/new-business and non-operating residuals as explicit non-base questions rather than imputing them into the compressor route.

industry_future_thesis.adaptation: The company has three compressor brands and reported efforts to stabilize Europe and develop the Americas, Southeast Asia, and domestic markets, plus new non-compressor activities. Those actions show breadth of response but do not establish separately observable unit returns or cash conversion for the new activities.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: The company supplies globally known refrigerator enterprises, earns its disclosed main business from refrigerator and commercial compressors, and reports that Jiaxipera is its main profit source; the supplied reports do not disclose customer contracts, concentration, or component-level cash conversion.
industry_future_thesis.horizon: The next reporting cycles after the 2018-12-31 cutoff.
industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: A mature compressor supply regime in which volume and geographic expansion can coexist with raw-material pressure, customer bargaining, and working-capital absorption.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: The factual three-year recurring-profit record is 184.97 million CNY in FY2015, 203.18 million CNY in FY2016, and 60.29 million CNY in FY2017. It supports a broad historical core-earnings reference rather than a claim that the FY2017 decline is fully temporary.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: The relevant loss path is not only solvency: continuing input-cost pressure, inventory-funded cash absorption, and capital retained in unsegmented acquisitions or projects could erode per-share owner economics even if the group continues to finance itself.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: For a design-and-production compressor supplier, raw-material cost pressure and the ability to recover it through customers transmit through recurring compressor profit; inventory funding and supplier-payment timing then transmit into aggregate operating cash and short-term financing need.
reversal_observations: A post-cutoff official report shows that compressor recurring profit recovers while disclosed major-raw-material pressure no longer reduces group and subsidiary profitability.
A post-cutoff official report shows operating cash conversion recovering without a further material rise in inventory-funded short-term borrowing.

Official disclosures separately reconcile the acquired or new non-compressor businesses from invested capital through earnings, working capital, and cash generation on the same responsibility boundary.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: Unresolved named rival: the supplied reports name no competitor; the strongest evidenced competitive challenge is alternative compressor supply to global refrigerator OEMs combined with customer bargaining under raw-material pressure.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use only a route anchored in the mature compressor earnings record with conditional treatment for aggregate owner-cash conversion; exclude unsegmented acquisition and new-business growth until responsibility-matched earnings, cash, and capital data are disclosed.

situation_model.summary: The disclosed enterprise is a production-led refrigerator and commercial-compressor supplier with global refrigerator-OEM exposure. Revenue grew through FY2017, but recurring attributable profit fell sharply as major raw-material costs rose; aggregate operating cash turned negative while inventory and short-term borrowings increased.
